description: This file contains unit tests for the 'completion' function in the litellm package, specifically testing integration with the DataRobot API via the HTTPHandler class. The tests verify correct URL usage, environment variable handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: test_completion_datarobot()
methods.description: Tests the completion function with a fixed DataRobot endpoint and checks the correctness of request parameters and API call.

methods.name: test_completion_datarobot_with_deployment()
methods.description: Tests the completion function with a deployment-specific URL set via environment variable, validating the URL and request data.

methods.name: test_completion_datarobot_with_environment_variables()
methods.description: Tests the completion function's behavior when environment variables are set for API token, ensuring proper response structure.
